text:
maya.marketing: noticed uptick in manual claims after webinar — ~2% of HS leads never reach RR claimers when enrichment lags.
jamal.ops: can you paste an example trace? is fallback queue swallowing records? :eyes: 
maya.marketing: repro: HS webhook -> enrich svc 8-10s -> router TTL=5s -> routes to BackfillQueue. SDRs only poll RR.
sam.sdr: this creates noise. Can we hold leads briefly so enrichment finishes? even 45s would help.
olivia.eng: quick mitigation: add a short-lived "gateway_hold" path. Router rule: if lead.property.gateway_hold==true and enrich_status!=done then hold up to 45s, recheck every 5s, then fall back. I'll add a feature flag.
ken.salesops: on HubSpot side, we can set gateway_hold=true for workflow outputs and have enrich webhook flip enrich_status=done when finished. Also tag owner=unassigned so SDR inboxes don't get cluttered.
jamal.ops: also add metrics: gateway_hold_count, enrichment_latency_ms, percent_held_over_30s. alert if >1% leads exceed 45s.
maya.marketing: timeline? need before next campaign.
olivia.eng: aim for canary in 24h. PR in routing-service soon.
lead-router-bot: routing-gateway patch deployed to canary (olivia.eng) :rocket: 
ken.salesops: will update HS workflow in sandbox and test re-submits.
sam.sdr: please add a short playbook note so SDRs know not to claim gateway-held leads unless enrich_status=done.
maya.marketing: thanks — let's review metrics after canary and iterate.
